contract: native8-bit decoded original Y/Cb/Cr grids/source words and padding; literal header/entropy windows; explicit independent-reset interpretation separate from default; stock display observations independent

jpeg_reference.policy: raw tj3DecompressToYUV8 only after native header precision/dimension/subsampling and byte admission; no RGB/chroma expansion

libtiff_reference.version:
LIBTIFF, Version 4.7.2

lzw_reference.policy: decode complete raw LZW payload, retaining full final-strip padding rather than libtiff logical-row clipping

modern_jpeg_reference.policy: aligned original JPEG chunks, explicit YCbCr output with nearest replication; exact inverse decimation recovers source chroma grids. LibTIFF RAW can return partially zero-filled modern JPEG units and is not used for compression7.

remaining.reason: existing OJPEG native component API is explicitly8-bit DCT; no promotion, downcast or guessed predictor

remaining.profile: header beyond first source part with multiple ambiguous entropy contributors
noncomplete subsampled planar or planar multiple strips/restarts
table-only multi-across without caller reset interpretation
remaining.action: default rejection; explicit IndependentResetTiles policy qualified separately
